# The Last Click

> The Last Click is an AI-first game studio in Athens, Greece. We pair human creativity with AI to build mobile games with a world of their own. One AI studio, endless possibilities.

Legal name: THE LAST CLICK L.P. · Athens (Maroussi), Greece · Founded by Jim Tsipoutas (https://jimtsipoutas.com)

## Games
- **ShipDuel** — Make your name at sea. Changed seas, unlikely captains: a name to make, one duel at a time. Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.
- **TinyDerby** — Small players, big rivalries. Take your shot and make every move matter. Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.
- **BoomBoats** — Your move makes waves. Plot your move, make it count. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6794503743) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.jimtsip.boomboats) · [boomboats.com](https://boomboats.com)
- **DadLine: Family Rush** — The city has other plans. The family has a list; step into the everyday chaos. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6802018413)

## Contact
Use the form at https://thelastclick.ai/#contact — tell us what you want to build. We reply within two working days.
